project: VerityFlow — SHODH 2026 AI/ML Engineer Intern submission
packaging_note: All measurements below were produced from source revision 56f5bb49eeb29eff3c2b65e91e3368e5c29f61e7. The final packaging commit that adds this report, docs/submission_readiness.md, the label audit, the traceability matrix, the offline verification logs and the README/AI-note updates contains documentation and reports only; it does not change src/, tests/, fixtures/, evaluation data, schemas or sealed artifacts.
determination_reasoning: Every mandatory Stage 1–4 capability listed in the assignment maps to implementation, tests and evaluation evidence; 25 of 27 traceability rows are implemented and tested, 1 is implemented and partially verified, 1 is explicitly unsupported, and none is silently unimplemented.
The final CPU-only offline verification exits 0 with 411 tests passing, schema-valid reports, unchanged sealed manifests and no credentials or network.
The original Stage 4 result (27/27 development, 8/10 sealed) is preserved unchanged and is not replaced or merged with the 22/22 remediation development result.

The determination is not READY because: the sealed result is 8/10 and was not re-measured; live Gemini quality is unmeasured; the remediation label audit is AI re-derivation by the implementation author, not independent human review; and the datasets are small synthetic sets, not an external benchmark.

test_evidence_basis.execution: 411 passed in the final offline verification with model credentials removed

unsupported_scope: Real live Gemini/model semantic quality: no live call was made; only synthetic fake-client scenarios are evaluated.
Arbitrary Python: only a restricted AST subset is interpreted, by design.
Natural-language requirements outside the documented grammar: disclosed as coverage gaps and produce INCOMPLETE.
Sealed-case performance after remediation: sealed cases were not rerun; only retained Stage 4 sealed results are reported.
The label audit is an AI re-derivation plus oracle cross-check, not independent human review.

auditor.identity: Qoder AI assistant, also the implementation author
auditor.type: AI re-derivation and oracle cross-check; not an independent human reviewer
auditor.independence_statement: The labels were authored in this repository. This audit re-derived every label from bundle bytes and cross-checked it with evaluation/oracle.py, which imports no reviewer code, but both the labels and this audit were produced with the same AI assistant. No independent human review is claimed.

label_audit.independence: The labels and this audit were produced by the same AI assistant. Cross-checking with the separately written oracle is not equivalent to independent human review, and no such review is claimed.

original_stage4_evaluation.status: retained, unchanged, not re-run during remediation

finding_quality_gaps: G03: status and PRECEDENCE category correct; expected witness tickets did not match because run_final_evaluation.py compares display strings
G04: reported SCRIPT_DISAGREEMENT instead of THRESHOLD_CHANGED; boundary witness failed the same comparison

root_cause_audits.F03: Approval hashes exactly the C1@1 5000->3000 usd change while spec Q3 and workflow r3 still encode 5000, so the two THRESHOLD_CHANGED blockers are behaviorally correct. The PASS expectation comes from the Stage 1-only STAGE1_STATUS table in scripts/run_final_evaluation.py, which does not model Stage 2 artifact comparison.
root_cause_audits.G05: Expected INCOMPLETE for an unresolved approval conflict, but the pre-remediation reviewer verified only the confirmed base; a spec/workflow at 25 against the disputed change became STRUCTURAL/WRONG_DESTINATION blockers. The remediation conflict-analysis pass targets this path and is exercised by development cases I-L, but no sealed case was rerun.
root_cause_audits.G03: Status and precedence category were correct; the witness check in scripts/run_final_evaluation.py compared requirement_outcome ("destination 'manual_review'") with the label value ("manual_review") and could never match. The retained witness is valid.

remaining_risks: The sealed result remains 8/10; F03, G05, G03 and G04 are disclosed, and no sealed case was rerun or tuned against.
The remediation 22/22 result is development evidence on newly authored bundles, not unseen-case accuracy.
The label audit is AI re-derivation and oracle cross-check by the implementation author, not independent human review.
Live Gemini quality, latency and cost are unmeasured; only 17 fake-client contract scenarios were exercised.
Datasets are small and repository-authored, not an external benchmark; coverage of production language is unknown.
Six remediation label tickets maps contain unscored documentation discrepancies; status, defect, threshold and applied-change labels are unaffected.
Two of 18 identifying findings in the Stage 4 rerun have non-exact message witnesses (16/18), so witness wording is not fully uniform.
JSON evidence excerpts are canonical projections, not byte-exact formatting.
Page counts were measured with one local Chrome renderer; other renderers may paginate differently.
final_statement: VerityFlow is ready for submission with the limitations above disclosed. The deterministic reviewer, its evidence, its evaluation separation and its reproducibility are supported by executed evidence at revision 56f5bb4; the sealed 8/10 result and the absence of live-model measurement are not presented as success.
